events.action: {"message": "Fixed the defect in `tests/kernel/context/src/main.c` where `k_yield_entry()` called `k_sleep(K_MSEC(50))` instead of `k_yield()` after raising its priority above the helper thread's priority. Calling `k_sleep()` blocked the cooperative worker thread for 50 ms, allowing the lower-priority helper thread to run and increment `thread_evidence` to 2, which then caused the assertion at line 859 to fail when the worker woke up during `test_timer_interrupts`.\n\nReplaced `k_sleep(K_MSEC(50))` with `k_yield()` and verified that the `tests/kernel/context` test suite builds and passes on `native_sim`.", "kind": "FinishAction"}
